title: Global dimension of dg algebras via compact silting objects
summary: We introduce a notion of global dimension for a triangulated category relative to a compact silting object. We prove that the finiteness of this dimension is an intrinsic property of the triangulated category itself and, therefore, independent of the choice of the silting object. Focusing on the setup of connective differential graded (dg) algebras, we analyse the behaviour of global dimension under dg algebra homomorphisms and establish explicit bounds.
